methods.expected_human_endorsement: Within-image mean human endorsement of the labels selected across successful repeats.
methods.condition_macro_expected_endorsement: Unweighted mean of image-level expected endorsements; this is the primary aggregation.
methods.condition_micro_expected_endorsement: Secondary mean of image-level expected endorsements weighted by each image's human n_responses.
modal_tie_break_order: None of these / Not clearly moral in nature
methods.stability: Modal label count divided by successful repeats.
methods.pairwise_label_agreement: Proportion of repeat pairs with the same label.
methods.sign_flip_test: Two-sided exact enumeration of signs for paired image-level deltas.
methods.bootstrap: Percentile bootstrap resampling paired images with replacement.

configured_primary_inference.interpretation: Report effect size and uncertainty. Treat a positive estimate with a confidence interval wholly above zero and p < 0.05 as evidence of improvement within this pilot; otherwise report the result as worse or inconclusive rather than proving equivalence.

methods.configured_repeat_policy: Three repeats estimate each image-condition response distribution and are averaged within image; they are never treated as independent inferential observations.
methods.configured_mixed_none_policy: Primary analysis retains responses as recorded. Sensitivity analysis removes only the None endorsement from the three responses that selected None together with at least one moral label; denominators do not change.
methods.mcnemar: Two-sided exact binomial McNemar test on discordant images.
